cases.description: Registration record, monad-testnet: a type-2 attestation of a schema-3 statement carrying the migrated profile entries (field 9), an expiry, and one algorithm-1 signature by the subject. Accept twin of every reg-crypto-* reject.
Registration record, monad-mainnet: the same shape on the second first-slice network with a fractional-millisecond timestamp.
Same-subject update: greater revision, no key transition, network unchanged. Live against the current codecs because the statement carries no profile entries.

A schema-2 reader lists type 4 at schema 2, so the schema-3 statement is read through V6.3: fields 0-8 are interpreted and field 9 is retained as an unknown field. Pins the exact profile-entry encoding while the bytes are live in both codecs.
An Ed25519 (key type 2) subject with an algorithm-16 signature entry is an allocated S2b pairing, so stage 8.3 accepts it and stage 9 sees a subject-signed entry.
Subject account-ref with key type 1 and a 32-byte key. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-statement-typed.
Subject account-ref with key type 1 carrying a 65-byte uncompressed key: the app already uses compressed keys, so this is a wrong encoding for the allocated length.
Algorithm-1 signature of 7 bytes, below the S2b minimum of 8. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-statement-typed.
Signature algorithm 99 is unallocated (S2a). Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-statement-typed.
Algorithm 1 with a key type 3 (x-only) signer: an S2b pairing violation, not a signature failure. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-statement-typed.
A schema-2 statement carrying field 9: C12 makes the undeclared key a schema error at the exact supported schema. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-statement-typed.
A schema-1 statement carrying field 9 (and no stamp key): undeclared at schema 1 (C12).
Statement network "Monad-Testnet" violates the S1 lowercase-tag syntax.
The opened type-4 statement emits key 4 before key 3: pass B reports the first non-canonical key order (the child carries its own stage label).
A same-subject update whose schema_version (2) is lower than the prior statement's (3): a subject cannot drop a stamp key it published (S10a.2).
Profile-entry headers not sorted bytewise by name (M4/C11): a stage 9 semantic reject. Forward-looking: the current codecs fail earlier at C12 (schema 8.2, undeclared key 9).
Duplicate header name "lang" in one profile entry (M4/C11). Forward-looking: the current codecs fail earlier at C12 (schema 8.2, undeclared key 9).
Bootstrap registration on monad-testnet: every stage-10 check passes - the algorithm-1 signature verifies over the frozen T2 transcript of the exact type-4 frame.

The same bootstrap shape without profile entries: the stage-10 isolation record. Every reg-crypto-* and reg-unsupported-* reject derives from this frame, so the current codecs accept it at typed today and only the stage-10 check is forward-looking.
Bootstrap registration on monad-mainnet, verified identically.
Same-subject update on monad-testnet: the prior statement is the entry-less bootstrap, the revision is greater, no transition is required, and the new signature verifies.
One byte of the minimal bootstrap signature differs: the digest no longer verifies (T6). Pair of reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full.

The record claims monad-mainnet but the signature was made over the monad-testnet transcript of the same statement: T5 binds the transcript network to field 0, so verification fails while every stage-9 rule holds. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full (the same statement on its own network).

The exact minimal bootstrap statement signed over the key-transition transcript domain instead of frank/directory-signature/v1: the T2 digest differs, verification fails. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full (same statement, matching domain).
The s integer's DER length byte claims one byte more than it carries: strict-DER parsing (S2a/M5) fails before any curve arithmetic. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full.
The bootstrap digest signed with s = n - s_low: a validly encoded signature above n/2, rejected by the algorithm-1 low-S rule (S2a/M5). Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full.
The subject is 02 || p-1: a well-formed key-type-1 account-ref that is not a curve point, so stage 10.6 cannot verify the signature by it. Accept twin: reg-fixture-testnet-minimal-full.

An allocated algorithm-16 (Ed25519) entry is recognized at 8.3, but the first slice verifies only algorithm 1 (M7): the attestation is unsupported, not cryptographic, because no verification ran (V3). Typed twin (recognized): reg-alg16-recognized-typed.
